Subject: SOC2 renewal - temporary retention carveout request

Connor —

Thanks again for the quick demo last month. We're starting the SOC 2 renewal runbook at Starlite and have a couple of asks that may need a short-term contract amendment: 

1) We need a 90-day, staggered snapshot handoff for a subset of audit logs (payments subsystem) to assist our external auditor. This is temporary for the renewal window only.
2) For the same 90 days we require a retention carveout to keep high-fidelity request logs at 120 days (our default is 30).
3) We'll likely increase ingestion capacity during the handoff window and want pricing for a short-term seat bump + burst GPU capacity.

Attached is the formal request and a sketch of which indices are in scope (starlite-soc2-request-2026-09-20.pdf). Can your team confirm feasibility and an estimated cost / amendment path by end of next week?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

— Megan

Connor / Kim —

Quick technical plan below (high level) for the staggered snapshot handoff: 

- Scope: payments indices (payments-events-*, payments-audit-*) — matches their attachment.
- Routing: create a temporary routing policy to mirror those indices to a dedicated staging pool (s3-archive + local kv cache). We can apply a TTL override of 120d for that mirrored store.
- Snapshot cadence: nightly full snapshot + hourly incremental for 2-week audit window (first 14 days), then nightly afterwards.
- Evidence artifacts: snapshot checksums, manifest.json, sample query logs (sanitized) — I suggest using our existing "snapshot-routing-diagram.pdf" for the auditor.

Attachments: attaching initial matrix: log-retention-matrix.xlsx (stub).

Constraints / notes:
- Data residency: Must confirm that the staging pool will remain in us-west-2; if Starlite requires splitting EU/US we need separate approval.
- Rollout estimate: 3 business days to create routing + test. 1 additional day for export automation.

I'll draft the runbook and checklist by EOD 9/24.

— Priyom

Thanks Priyom — plan looks good. Pricing notes below for proposal to Megan: 

- 3-month retention carveout (additional storage + retention policy): $6,500 (fixed one-time configuration + monthly storage prorated).
- Short-term seat bump (10 seats, 3 months): $2,400/month (discounted 15% for short-term).
- Burst GPU capacity: estimate $1,800/week for the 2-week high-ingest window, then $600/week thereafter during the 90-day period if required.
- SLA credits: no change to baseline SLA for temporary routing; if they require dedicated physical pool we can offer 99.95% SLA with an uplift but that's a different contract path.

I'll assemble a one-page amendment (term: 90 days starting on agreed handoff date) and include cost table + acceptance checkbox. Connor — want me to include a 30% caretaker discount if they sign within 5 business days? We can use that to accelerate commitment.

Kim
